info.title: SmartGN - Payments & Billing
info.description: Verified purchases, tokenized payment methods, paid subscription periods, technical coverage and fiscal documents. Owns an independent PostgreSQL database and integrates through authenticated HTTP and durable events. Local fixtures do not establish productive external integration.

tags.name: Checkout
tags.description: Server-priced provisional purchases protected by private checkout secrets.

tags.description: Principal-owned provider tokens and masked payment metadata.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Authoritative paid periods, entitlements and renewal consent.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Owned orders, verified payment operations and financial history.

tags.name: Technical statements
tags.description: Frozen cost, coverage and balance after a completed visit.

tags.name: Billing documents
tags.description: Owned fiscal metadata and downloadable test or provider artifacts.
